sentences.en: The gradual ruin of our country has to be stopped.
sentences.zh: 我们必须阻止我们国家的逐渐衰落。

sentences.en: There's a gradual disappearing of the power of the British Empire.
sentences.zh: 大英帝国的实力正在逐步消失。

sentences.en: Gradual changes take place in our city every year.
sentences.zh: 我们的城市每年都在发生着平缓的变化。
